content: Ankum, làkyer balàbal anà nkɔ̈ɔ̈n a nsöön akà asɔ abɛ, làyöb naa bɛ sye, bɛ làbye anà Nkum mwɛy u du.
Nkääl akà baar abà u nsà
Làsi muküünà u ngyamàkà, amu ya, làkäl kà ikyɛɛŋ anà làfuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam.
Mpal làyamà bɛ, làyamà sye ntɔn bi ntɔn Nzam kipɛ ipöl aŋàbwaŋ mulɔŋ ndaa ande, mukyään ngyee a Klistɔ, yà ntɔn ya in'wà mɛ u bɔlokà,
ntɔn mɛ in'sam ya ubwaŋàbwaŋ asànaa an'kwo mɛ musam ya.
Abà, làkäl anà an'yeerà unsà nkääl abɛ akà baar mpa abà aklistɔ, anà làsyääl taaŋ.
Wɛy an'yääm abɛ màkäl màŋàbwaŋ taaŋ lanswà, màŋàsà muŋ, anà nkwaar mufuur akà mbuur wanswà.
Mbɔr a ntsüü
Tishik, un'tɔŋ wànkween, un'syääl mwɛy wàlää, un'baay amɛ unsà isal a Mwol, akyer ayàlasam làsaŋ amɛ lanswà.
Mɛ, mɛ amàlatööm awà abun ntɔn mukàlasam làsaŋ abi anà mukàlalɛɛl.
Ɔnɛsim, un'tɔŋ wàlää anà nkween, umwɛy uboo a bɛ, wàmuyà mbwo mwɛy anà nde. Ba bàyàlasam indiir byanswà ikalyaaŋà kà.
Aristark, awà u bɔlokà anà mɛ, kàmàlatööm mbɔr mbɔɔn, anà Malakɔ sye, un'tɔŋ a Barnabas. Bɛ làkyàwal nswɛɛŋ ntɔn nde : isàkal naa nde kan'yà akà bɛ, lun'wɛl ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Yɛsu awà bàfàbel Yüstüs, kàmàlatööm mbɔr. Ba mpɛl uboo a Ayudà abàmusal anà mɛ ntɔn Imwol a Nzam. Ba bàkäl ndɛɛl ntɔn mɛ.

Ɛpafras, nde sye wà umwɛy uboo abɛ, un'syääl a Klistɔ mpa afàyɔn munwaan ità u ngyamàkà ande, ntɔn bɛ làkäl bàŋàtsim, bàŋàbwaŋ, anà ntɔn muswaŋ ngyööl a an'kyän a ukwen a Nzam banswà.
Mɛ amun'tɛɛl imbäl ki naa nde afàsal ngwal mbɔɔn ntɔn bɛ, ntɔn baar a bul a Lawɔdisɛ anà bà bul a Yɛlapɔlis.
Lukà, un'ngaŋ, un'saam abi anà Dɛmas bàmàlatööm mbɔr.
Apɛ atɔŋ abà u bul a Lawɔdisɛ mbɔr, anà Nɛmfa, anà Ikööŋ ifàköŋ u ndwà ande.
Mpal làsàmay bɛ mutaŋ un'kaan amɛ, làkyer mbwo yanswà naa bàtäŋ wa sye u Ikööŋ a Lawɔdisɛ. Làtäŋ sye anà wa akwà asàfà Lawɔdisɛ.
Abun, lun'kyään Arship naa: « Tà mpi isal kàwɛl ngye unsà Mwol, ntɔn ngye akwey kya ubwaŋàbwaŋ. »
Le mbɔr a kɔɔ amɛ Pɔl yayi: Làyɔbà naa mɛ in'wà u bɔlokà. Wɛy kab a ngway a Nzam làkäl anà bɛ!
